intro: Build High-Converting Shopify Stores with AI in 2026.
overview: This professional course is designed to help students build modern, high-converting Shopify e-commerce stores using the latest AI tools, automation systems, conversion optimization strategies, and real-world client workflows. The course starts from Shopify fundamentals and gradually moves into advanced store development, dropshipping operations, AI-assisted design systems, Shopify SEO, speed optimization, tracking setup, and freelancing/client projects. Students will work on multiple live projects and learn industry-standard workflows used by modern Shopify developers and agencies.
